findings_forced_to_provisional: ** None. No findings qualified as blocked_url_index_verified. The primary expected source for provisional findings — Reddit (r/patreon, r/PatreonMemes) — was comprehensively blocked with no mirrors, Google Cache snapshots, or archive.org versions discoverable despite systematic attempts across old.reddit.com, web.archive.org, Google Cache URLs, and third-party mirrors. This represents a significant coverage gap; the shard's "WHERE TO LOOK FIRST" list includes two Reddit URLs that could not be accessed by any method.
findings_degraded_to_could_not_verify: ** F-X03 (State of Create, pre-window date), F-X04 (Graphtreon, no date stamp), F-X05 (Similarweb, paywalled), F-X06 (Patreon podcasts page, no measurement period), F-X07 (Passion.io, secondary source + pre-window data), F-X08 (Skillademia, missing period + source), F-X09 (Key-G, unclear methodology), F-X10 (Backlinko 10M figure, period unspecified for underlying stat), F-X13 (Variety, 403 fetch block), F-X14 (Axios, 403 fetch block).
findings_degraded_due_to_url_not_fixable: ** F-X13 (Variety) and F-X14 (Axios) were both accessible in search engine indexes but not via direct page fetch (403 errors). Per edge-case rules, search engine snippets do not constitute a mirror of the same URL, so these were degraded to Part 4 rather than classified as blocked_url_index_verified.
multi_speaker_pages_split: ** All Trustpilot findings (F-01 through F-11) are from the same multi-speaker paginated review listing at https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.patreon.com. Each finding captures one distinct reviewer's voice. BBB findings (F-12) similarly from a multi-speaker complaint listing, split by individual complaint.
truncated_sources: ** Initial Trustpilot review fetches returned truncated snippets for several reviews (soon chye leong, Lynn Lim, Jamie Ditch) in a sidebar summary view. Full untruncated text was recovered by fetching individual review listing pages (pages 3, 5). Full verbatim text confirmed for all Part 1 Trustpilot findings.
source_type_ambiguities: ** BBB complaints classified as buyer_review (patron-filed complaints about their purchasing experience). Graphtreon classified as report (third-party data tracker). Backlinko and InsideAudioMarketing classified as article (professional editorial content citing primary sources). Passion.io classified as blog (competitor's content marketing). These classifications are conservative within the allowed shard types.
sd05_patron_comparisons_to_alternative_p: Only indirect comparison found (F-05 mentions switching to "alternative platforms" without naming specific competitors). No patron reviews with explicit named-platform comparisons (e.g., "Patreon vs. Ko-fi as a buyer") were located within the time window.
sd07_patron_tenureloyalty_patterns: Limited data. F-06 mentions ~1 year tenure, F-10 mentions "a few years," F-12 mentions annual subscription. No systematic tenure data found.
sd11sd12_reddit: Complete absence due to access block.
sd14_sitejabber: Complete absence; no reviews in window.
sd19_youtube_patron_transcripts: Complete absence; only creator-side content found.
positive_patron_voice_is_underrepresente: only 2 of 15 Part 1 findings reflect positive experience (F-10, and to a limited extent the aggregate data findings). This reflects the composition of the accessible Trustpilot/BBB review corpus, which skews heavily negative. Positive patron voices likely exist on platforms not accessed (Reddit, Discord, social media).
cases_where_input_could_not_be_decompose: ** None. All sub-searches derive directly from the shard's scope, qualifiers, and "WHERE TO LOOK FIRST" sources.
